chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

No wind ever comes out except in measure, except in the time of ʿĀd, for it rebelled against its keepers and came out through something like the eye of a needle, and so it destroyed the people of ʿĀd.

key_terms.خَرْقِ الْإِبْرَةِ: the eye or opening of a needle

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the destructive wind sent upon the people of ʿĀd?
ai.summary: The hadith states that winds ordinarily emerge according to precise measure and control. The exception was the wind sent upon the people of ʿĀd, which overwhelmed restraint and became the means of their destruction, pointing to divine power and punishment in history.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "No wind ever blows except in measure, except during the time of the people of ‘Aad, for it broke loose against its keepers and came out like the eye of a needle, destroying the people of ‘Aad."
